gloss: to spread; to become widespread; to become popular

definitions.gloss: to spread; to become widespread; to become popular; to come into wide use
definitions.explanation: For something — typically a product, technology, practice, or idea — to become widely used or adopted across a society or group. Implies reaching a broad audience.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンが{急速|きゅうそく}に{普及|ふきゅう}した。
{電気|でんき}{自動車|じどうしゃ}はまだ{十分|じゅうぶん}に{普及|ふきゅう}していない。
examples.english: Electric cars haven't yet become sufficiently widespread.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}によって、{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{情報|じょうほう}にアクセスできるようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to the spread of the internet, it became possible to access information from all over the world.

notes:
Commonly used in discussions about technology adoption, social trends, and policy outcomes. Often appears as a noun ({普及|ふきゅう}) modifying other words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普及|ふきゅう}{率|りつ} — adoption rate, penetration rate
- {普及|ふきゅう}{活動|かつどう} — outreach activities, promotional efforts
- {普及|ふきゅう}{啓発|けいはつ} — awareness-raising and education
- {急速|きゅうそく}に{普及|ふきゅう}する — to spread rapidly
- ～の{普及|ふきゅう}に{伴|ともな}い — along with the spread of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {広|ひろ}まる — to spread; more casual and general
- {浸透|しんとう}する — to permeate; implies gradual, deep absorption into society
- {流行|りゅうこう}する — to be in fashion, to be trendy; implies temporary popularity
- {定着|ていちゃく}する — to become established; focuses on being firmly rooted
